keep.name: sidebar header
keep.why: The traffic lights, sidebar toggle, back/forward and new-workspace buttons are shared by every page; opening Settings never moves them.

keep.name: settings header
keep.why: The Settings tab title, search field and section tabs (General first) are the page's navigation; their order and spacing change only on purpose.

keep.name: window card
keep.why: The General > Window card (Titlebar, Titlebar Buttons, Global Hot Key, Start Agent from Any App, Dock and menu bar icons) is the reference settings card layout.
